The two input images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: confident flat editorial drawings, beautifully composed large typography, charming simplified shapes, harmonious vivid colors and a left-edge book fold. Invent a new composition, do not copy their scenes. Clearly drawn illustration with strong clean silhouettes and only a few intentional details, at most one flat shadow shade per object. No photorealism, realistic anatomy, 3D rendering, collage or grain. People have coherent simplified eyes and hands, naturally colored skin. No perspective mockup, external shadow, logos, author names, year, watermark, or extra text. Only the exact Spanish title and subtitle below, preserving all accents and punctuation.
Exact title: El capital en el siglo XXI
Exact subtitle: Cómo se acumula la riqueza y por qué aumenta la desigualdad
Art direction: Deep saturated cobalt background. Three stacks of warm-golden coins form very unequal building silhouettes across lower half, one towering on right and two much lower left. A warm-cream stairway winds between the stacks and stops short of the highest tower, subtle metaphor for unequal access. No people, currency symbols, axes or numerical claims. Huge warm-cream heavy slab serif title across upper half, capital dominant and XXI prominent, exact title. Subtitle dark navy on a broad pale-apricot foreground at bottom. Distinctive geometric editorial drawing with coral window accents, no realistic metallic sheen.
